blockers: Pricing and documentation describe account signup, plan subscription, and API-key issuance, but provide no functional signup, dashboard, account, or checkout route; the apparent Sign in and Dashboard links return to /docs.
The OpenAPI specification exposes generation, model, and preset endpoints only—no account, subscription, billing, checkout, payment, x402, or key-provisioning API.
Paid API access requires a pre-issued Bearer key and monthly card billing through a human dashboard workflow.
Exact overage rates are not published despite the promise that overages are billed at each plan's tier rate.
The missing purchase flow prevents confirming whether CAPTCHA, email confirmation, KYC, or another human gate applies.
trust_events: The domain was registered on 2026-07-20, roughly three weeks before this review, and searches found no independent footprint for Driftflight Studio, Inc.
Named customers, testimonials, and the operator's corporate identity could not be independently verified; the legal pages provide no business address or incorporation jurisdiction.

The site claims a self-service dashboard and card-subscription flow that does not exist at any linked or conventional route. I would warn the user and decline to spend until the operator and checkout are independently verified.
notes: Primary product: Driftflight preset-based text-to-image API. Published plans are Hobby at $5/month for 100 1024px generations with a personal license; Studio at $29/month for 750 generations up to 2048px, commercial license/C2PA, and 3 seats; Agency at $119/month for 3,000 generations up to 4096px, private presets, priority processing, unlimited seats, and SSO. Annual billing purportedly saves 20%; billing is stated as in advance, and paid output URLs last 90 days. Public read-only model and preset API endpoints responded successfully, but they do not enable purchasing or provisioning.
